initializer_references.method: Scan every possible four-byte image word, normalizing physical aliases, and every aligned SH halfword for direct BSR/BRA targets. This tests encoded references, not arbitrary computed indirect calls.

sdk_heap.finding: The supported allocator is linked, but no encoded entry reference starts it. This is the same kind of gap as Crazy Taxi 2, rather than an omitted target-register variant in initializer-call discovery. There is no present basis for claiming an ordinary allocator-backed runtime lease.

startup_and_memory.c_start: 0x8c0cfd20, reached from the entry's pointer at 0x8c01002c
startup_and_memory.fixed_upper_ram: Actual PC-relative loads name 0x8ce60000 and many 0x8cfe0000-0x8cffffff game-state addresses. They exclude assumptions based on Crazy Taxi 2's map; static absence of other literals proves no unused interval.
startup_and_memory.sdk_vector_setup: The initial game setup calls 0x0c0d3680 once at 0x8c0116c0. Its nested 0x0c0e1340 routine copies the SDK vectors into the live VBR. Later setup calls 0x0c0d36aa, then the proved Maple-init tail thunk at 0x0c024100.
startup_and_memory.future_hook_limit: A future fixed-arena hook must run after the live vector and Maple layout are initialized and must survive later setup. The initial SDK call alone is not admitted here as a hook. No initialization site or arena is added to the fixed-plan table.

next_console_test.question: Which contiguous upper-RAM pages remain untouched across two separate cold-boot gameplay sessions with differing content and transitions?
next_console_test.expected_route: New (X) selects the standalone RAM-map reader when the combined module refuses the absent heap initializer slot.
next_console_test.evidence: Photograph each return screen with all four RAM UNUSED words, build ID, and a short account of the modes/stages played.
next_console_test.not_established: No permanent unused interval, allocator arena, virtual-card admission, or console saving is established by this static analysis.
